title: Earthy Italian Wrap
description: A delicious and healthy wrap filled with earthy mushrooms and Italian flavors.

ingredients.name: Mushrooms
ingredients.notes: Earthier mushrooms like cremini or shiitake work well

ingredients.name: Italian Sausage
ingredients.notes: Use a vegetarian sausage alternative for a vegan version

ingredients.name: Wrap
ingredients.notes: Italian flatbread or a similar wrap works best

ingredients.name: Tomato
ingredients.notes: Fresh or canned, whichever is available

ingredients.name: Cure Pepperoni
ingredients.notes: For added flavor, use a small amount of cured pepperoni

ingredients.name: Pesto
ingredients.notes: Classic Italian sauce made from basil and olive oil

instructions: Preheat a pan to medium heat.
Add the sliced Italian sausage and cook until browned.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until tender.
Add the sliced tomato and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Warm the wrap in the pan for about 30 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spreading pesto on the wrap, then adding the cooked sausage, mushroom, and tomato mixture.
Add sliced cure pepperoni on top for added flavor.
Fold the wrap to enclose the filling and serve.
Optional: Add shredded cheese or additional toppings as desired.
